label: Teltonika TAP400
description: Wi-Fi 6 access point with a single 2.5 GbE RJ45 port.
notes: Vendor figures from the TAP400 datasheet: **1x RJ45 100/1000/2500 Mbps** port and 802.11ax. The **2.5 GbE port is the useful part** - an AP with a gigabit port cannot carry a full Wi-Fi 6 radio pair, and this one can. Sourced from a distributor mirror of Teltonika's datasheet (the vendor's own PDF did not extract), so the model name was checked against the document before use.
